# ClinicFlow (كلينك فلو)
> Next-Generation Multi-Tenant Clinical Operating System & EHR/EMR SaaS for medical practices and healthcare polyclinics.

## Overview
ClinicFlow is a high-availability, offline-first clinical operating system tailored for doctors, dentists, polyclinics, and healthcare networks. It provides zero-friction phone-first patient booking, real-time live waiting queues with Web Audio chimes, electronic medical records (EMR), dental charting, dual-entry treasury ledgers, automated WhatsApp recalls, and strict tenant isolation via PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS).

## Core Capabilities
- Multi-Tenancy and Tenant Isolation: Per-clinic data partitioning with custom domain routing (e.g., clinic.com, slug.clinicflow.app, /c/:slug).
- High-Availability Offline-First Architecture: Local-first IndexedDB caching with autonomous background syncOutbox and circuit breakers.
- Phone-First Patient Booking: Zero-password, friction-free booking flow with Nebras digital QR appointment tickets.
- Clinical AI Assistant: Deep clinical reasoning, prescription generation, drug-drug interaction screening, and WhatsApp recall automation.
- Enterprise Financial Ledger: Dual-entry cash tracking, split partner percentages, invoice generation, and shift cash drawer handover.
- Regulatory Egyptian Telecommunication Integration: NTRA-certified Egyptian SMS sender ID validation and telecom gateway protocols.

## Key Public URLs
- [Homepage](https://clinicflow.app/): Main platform overview, interactive feature preview, and SaaS subscription tiers.
- [Clinic Discovery Hub](https://clinicflow.app/booking): Search and discover verified clinics and schedule consultations.
- [Patient Self-Service Portal](https://clinicflow.app/manage-booking): Query appointment tickets via booking code or phone number.
- [Clinic Staff & Doctor Portal](https://clinicflow.app/login): Unified authentication gateway for doctors, receptionists, and accountants.
- [Dr. Ahmed Dental Clinic Portal](https://clinicflow.app/c/dr-ahmed/booking): Example dedicated clinic booking interface.
- [Sitemap](https://clinicflow.app/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap for search engine indexing.
- [Full LLM Context](https://clinicflow.app/llms-full.txt): Complete technical documentation and API reference for AI agents.
